title: Tuning the drums and the Palace Theater drummer
summary: He tuned the bass drum to the guitar string, learning from a Palace Theater drummer identified as Emil Tasso, and says he was never a flashy drummer but supported his brother.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why
